title: Ndzingo Wa Torha
intro: Vaaki, lava a va navela vurhangeri leswaku va sirhelela mhaka ya vona, va endle xikombelo xa leswaku ku hlawuriwa ndhuna ehenhla ka vona. Loko xikombelo xa vona xi hlamuriwile, loyi a hlawuriweke u hlangane ni ku kanakana, hikuva munhu loyi a a nga ri na xiyimo xa misava lexi a a xi languterile. Loko ku nga si va ni ku lwisana lokukulu, murhangeri loyi lontshwa a a ta ringa ndzayo ya vuthu hi yoxe hi ku ringeta ku tikhoma ko olova, kambe loku dzikeke.
clues: Ndzi hlawuriwile ku va murhangeri endzhaku ka loko vanhu va mina va lave murhangeri leswaku a lwa endleleni ya Allah.
Vanhu vo tala va ka hina eku sunguleni va kanakane ku thoriwa ka mina, va boxa ku pfumaleka ka mina ka rifuwo ni rixaka ra xiyimo xa le henhla.
Ndzi hlawuriwile hikuva Allah u ndzi nyike vutivi byo tala ni xiyimo xa miri xa matimba.
Xikombiso lexi nga erivaleni xa ku thoriwa ka mina hi Xikwembu a ku ri ku vuya ka Areka ya Ntwanano, leyi rhwariweke hi tintsumi, leyi tiseke ku rhula etimbilwini ta vapfumeri.
Loko ndzi ri karhi ndzi macha ni masocha ya mina, ndzi tivise leswaku hi ta ringiwa hi nambu.
Ndzi lerise vuthu ra mina leswaku un’wana ni un’wana loyi a nwaka swinene enambyeni a nga ri wa ntlawa wa mina, kasi lava a va teka xikopu xin’we ntsena evokweni ra vona a va ta sala.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
